transcript: Speaker A: Hello sir, my husband is not available right now. Can I take a message and ask him to call you back? Speaker B: क्या? इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश कहाँ से सीखी? [What? Where did you learn such good English?] Speaker A: जब तुम ऑफिस में होते हो, तो मैं English Seekho ऐप पर एक AI टीचर के साथ रोज़ 10 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करती हूँ। और वो बहुत ही आसानी से मुझे सब कुछ सिखा देते हैं। [When you are at the office, I practice 10 minutes daily with an AI teacher on the English Seekho app. They teach me very easily.] Speaker B: वो तो समझ गया, लेकिन इसका खर्चा कितना है? [I get that, but how much does it cost?] Speaker A: एक कप चाय से भी कम। [Less than a cup of tea.] Speaker B: क्या बात कर रही हो! फिर तो मैं आज ही इसे ट्राई करूँगा। मुझे भी ऑफिस में इंग्लिश काम आएगी। कब तक एक ही सैलरी पर रहूँगा। [Really! Then I will try it today. English will help me at the office too. How long will I stay on the same salary?] Speaker A: क्या आप भी मेरी तरह सबको चौंकाना चाहते हैं? तो आज ही English Seekho इंस्टॉल करो और दो हफ़्तों में फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलो। [Do you also want to surprise everyone like me? Install English Seekho today and speak fluent English in two weeks.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: INSTALL NOW, English Seekho. Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority or brand. Names/trademarks are used for educational purposes. Results may vary.
summary: An animated skit features a wife surprising her husband with her fluent English, which she learned using the English Seekho app for 10 minutes a day. The husband decides to join to boost his career, highlighting the app's low cost. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
